snippet.description:
Секретную группу советских разведчиков отправили в глубокий немецкий тыл для выполнения особо опасного задания. Но в назначенное время бойцы не вышли на связь. Командование решило, что отряд уничтожен, а операция полностью провалена.

Однако спустя трое суток в немецких гарнизонах начали один за другим погибать высокопоставленные офицеры. Фашисты подняли по тревоге целые подразделения, перекрыли дороги и устроили масштабную облаву. Но никто не мог понять, кто наносит удары и откуда ждать следующего.

**Немцы думали, что уничтожили советскую разведгруппу… Но настоящая операция только начиналась! И когда фашисты наконец вышли на след диверсантов, их ждал удар, которого не ожидало даже немецкое командование!**

snippet.description:
Saudi Arabia reports fresh missile and drone attacks, with the Saudi-led coalition saying it intercepted threats aimed at the kingdom. The latest escalation comes after deadly attacks over the weekend and raises concerns that the conflict could widen further.
Oil remains in focus, with some analysts warning prices could reach $120 a barrel if fighting expands and disrupts additional supply routes.
Asian stocks extend losses as the AI trade comes under pressure, while global bond markets remain volatile. The IMF warns that surging yields are now a major risk to the financial system and says weaker banks could come under increasing strain if the AI boom reverses sharply.
The UK says Iran’s Revolutionary Guard directed activity at an airbase used by the US, adding to regional security concerns.
Donald Trump says Vladimir Putin and Volodymyr Zelensky need to come together to end the war, while Jared Kushner says a diesel-related initiative is aimed at softening Russia’s position.
In technology, Meta unveils its Muse Wonder model as competition in artificial intelligence intensifies. BYD plans a major hiring push in Europe, aiming to expand its regional workforce to around 40,000.
Elsewhere, India’s opposition marches over a voter dispute, while Egyptian Foreign Minister Badr Abdelatty discusses efforts to reduce tensions across the Middle East. Guests includes Yves Bonzon, Julius Baer Group CIO.

snippet.description:
SK하이닉스의 미국 낸드 자회사 솔리다임(Solidigm)이 나스닥 IPO(기업공개)를 공식 추진하면서 '해외 자회사 중복 상장' 논란이 거세지고 있습니다.

SK의 지배구조를 뜯어보면 ㈜SK 밑에 중간지주사, 그 밑에 SK하이닉스, 미국 법인, 그리고 솔리다임까지 무려 5단계에 걸친 복잡한 수직계열화 구조를 띠고 있습니다. 솔리다임 인수 자금은 낸드 불황과 주가 폭락을 온몸으로 견뎌낸 SK하이닉스 주주들의 피 같은 돈으로 마련되었으며, 적자 구간의 막대한 손실 역시 기존 주주들이 고스란히 감당해 왔습니다.

이제 겨우 AI 데이터센터향 eSSD 호조로 흑자 전환에 성공해 연결 실적의 결실을 보려는 순간, 현지 상장이라는 명분으로 핵심 결실을 떼어내 상장시키는 것은 명백한 주주가치 훼손이라는 비판이 쏟아지고 있습니다. 위험은 주주에게 전가하고 수익은 분리 상장으로 희석시키는 K-증시의 고질적 지배구조, 여러분은 이번 솔리다임 IPO를 어떻게 평가하시나요?

What happens if SP Velumani’s Coimbatore rebel conclave gathers 28 MLAs under the Tenth Schedule, forcing the Election Commission to freeze Two Leaves and giving CM Vijay an unshakeable 137-seat majority?

In this investigative breakdown on @SKATamil, Suresh Kumar Alphonse (SKA) deconstructs the political earthquake threatening Tamil Nadu. AIADMK won 47 seats in April, but by October 13, that tally is down to 41. Under Tenth Schedule Paragraph 4, if two-thirds (28 MLAs) sign a merger resolution, AIADMK legally dissolves into TVK. Crucially, the disqualification gavel is held by TVK Speaker J.C.D. Prabhakar—a former three-time AIADMK veteran. Following 3 days of secret meetings at SP Velumani’s Coimbatore house with CV Shanmugam, Thangamani, and Natham Viswanathan, SKA analyzes the 4 legal steps, the Eknath Shinde precedent, the 1988 Janaki lesson, and why 109 + 28 = 137 frees CM Vijay from Congress and VCK leverage.

snippet.title: New White House Press Secretary stumbles on words in first press briefing | AFP
snippet.description:
New White House Press Secretary Katie Zacharia made her briefing room debut by taking remarkably few questions from journalists while leaving no doubt who she believes has all the answers: Donald Trump

Little known to the general public, Zacharia opened her first session at the famous briefing room podium by reading — at a notably slow pace and stumbling on words — a lengthy list of what she said were achievements under the "energetic" leader.

Zacharia took questions from just three reporters, starting with right-wing website Breitbart, an outlet frequently accused of spreading conspiracy theories.

The next question went to Fox News, one of the key pillars of Trump's media support, and the last one to the Daily Mail tabloid website.
